messages:
noah: hey team, quick ping on day 1: where's the right place to post laptop arrival photos, badge request, and a note about my desk chair preference? also how do i enable the onboarding reminders?
rita: welcome! :tada: short guide: - laptop photos & arrival updates -> #new-hires (keep them in-thread) - badge/access -> #people-ops (or ping @sam) - chair/ergonomics -> #facilities - setup/ssh/VPN -> #eng-ops or #eng-infra
noah: thanks! is there a slash command for the onboarding checklist?
onboard-bot: Hello noah  You can enable the checklist with `/onboard enroll` (DMs by default). To set reminders to daily: `/onboard prefs --freq daily`. Visit https://intranet.redwood/onboarding to toggle web settings.
rita: pro tip: use `/onboard enroll --dm` if you don't want checklist items visible to the whole channel.
noah: where do i post if the laptop fails during imaging? short template?
itbot: Imaging issues -> post in #eng-infra. Use this minimal template:
- serial: XXXX-YYYY
- model: e.g., MacBookPro or ThinkPad
- symptom: e.g., stuck at apple logo / kernel panic
- steps tried: reflash, different USB, safe-mode
- availability for swap (timezone)
Attach a photo of the error screen and tag @eng-oncall if blocking.
noah: perfect. any etiquette on @mentions and gifs in #new-hires?
sam: keep #new-hires low-noise: reactions > +1 messages, threads for troubleshooting, avoid @channel unless truly org-wide. GIFs & fun stuff -> #random. also don't post PII (IDs, passport scans) in-channel; use the secure form.
noah: got it, submitted badge form and enrolled bot. thanks everyone! :smile:
